transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's really nice to meet you too. Thank you so much for taking the time to see me. 

Um, I guess... well, what finally made me come in is just that I've been having a little bit of trouble lately. It's probably not a huge deal, but I keep turning in applications or, like, my research notes, and they end up having these small, kind of embarrassing mistakes in them. Like, I'll mislabel an artwork date, or I'll just completely skip a question by accident. 

And I always feel terrible about it because I honestly thought I had checked everything really carefully before handing it in. I really try to do a good job and be diligent, I promise, it's just... I keep missing these little things. Does that make sense? I just wanted to see if that's something you could help me with, if that's okay.
Have you often had trouble paying attention to details or making careless mistakes since you were younger?

Um, yeah, I guess so. I mean, it's not like I was a bad kid or anything! I always tried really hard to be good in class. But, um... yeah, even back in elementary school, my teachers would usually write on my report cards that I had good ideas and stuff, which was nice of them to say. 

But they would also mention that I, um, forgot to turn in worksheets or lost instructions sometimes. Or that I missed little details. It wasn't because I didn't care, I promise! It's just... my parents kind of had to check my backpack every night to make sure I had everything, otherwise things would just sort of slip through the cracks. Is that the kind of thing you mean? I hope that's a helpful answer.
Do these kinds of attention slips happen in other parts of your life too, like at home or in conversations, not just with school or work tasks?

Um, well, I try really hard to be present, you know? I want people to know I'm listening to them. But... I guess maybe sometimes, at home, I might miss a beat in a conversation? Like, my roommate might be talking, and I'll realize I sort of drifted off for a second. But I always apologize right away! I never want anyone to feel like I'm ignoring them, because I'm really not. 

And, um, with chores and stuff... I usually get them done! Sometimes I might start doing the dishes and then get a little sidetracked by wiping down the counter, and then maybe I forget to finish the dishes right then. But I always go back and finish them eventually when I notice. It's really not too bad, I don't think. Most people probably do that sometimes, right? Am I answering your question okay?
Do you find yourself repeatedly checking your work over and over because you feel you have to?

Um, no, not really. I mean, I definitely try to check things over, like I said, just to be safe and do a good job. But I wouldn't say I do it over and over again, or like I'm obsessed with it or anything like that. 

I just try to give it a normal look-over before I hand it in. I don't feel like I *have* to keep checking it a million times. I usually just check it once or twice and then trust that I did my best. That's a pretty normal way to handle things, right? I just want to make sure I'm doing things the right way.
Do you tend to worry a lot about many different things, even when there isn’t a clear reason to?

Um, no, I don't think I do that. I mean, I really try to stay pretty upbeat, you know? Like, if there's a big exam coming up or a job interview or something, I might get a little stressed, but I think everyone gets nervous about big stuff like that, right? 

I don't really worry about things just out of nowhere, though. If everything is fine, I'm usually pretty good at just going with the flow and staying positive. I really try not to let things get to me if there isn't a good reason. So, yeah, I wouldn't say I'm a big worrier. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining that right.
Have these attention slips caused real problems for you in school, work, or relationships?

Um, well... I guess maybe a little bit? I really try my hardest to stay on top of things, I promise. But... yeah, I suppose there have been a few little hiccups. 

Like, I've turned in an assignment or two late, just because I lost track of time or got mixed up. And, um, I might have missed a couple of deadlines for some applications... but I'm really working on getting better at that! I even had my mentor mention that my, um, follow-through might be affecting some opportunities I'm up for. Which was hard to hear, because I really want to do a good job and make him proud. 

But it's not like I'm failing out or anything! It's just a few slip-ups here and there. I'm sure I can get it all back on track if I just try a little harder. Does that sound like a normal college thing, or is that the kind of problem you were asking about?
